checks.title: Microsoft traffic forwarded through Global Secure Access
remediation: In Entra, Global Secure Access, Connect, Traffic forwarding, enable the Microsoft traffic profile and assign it to all users.
Deploy the Global Secure Access client to Windows and macOS through Intune.
Turn on universal tenant restrictions so only the organisation's tenant can be signed in to through the client (NET-004 covers signaling).

userImpact.text: The Global Secure Access client runs in the background; Microsoft 365 works as before, only through Microsoft's network edge.

checks.narrative: Routing Microsoft 365 traffic through Global Secure Access lets Conditional Access require a compliant network and enforce tenant restrictions, which stops a token or session from being used against another tenant or from outside the organisation's path.

checks.title: Internet traffic filtered
remediation: Enable the Internet access traffic profile and assign it.
Create a web content filtering policy that blocks the categories the organisation does not allow (malware, phishing, newly registered domains at least) and link it to a security profile.
Apply the security profile through a Conditional Access policy for the users in scope.

userImpact.text: Sites in blocked categories show a block page; everything else browses as before.

checks.narrative: With the Internet Access profile on but no filtering policy linked, traffic flows through the service without being checked. A web content filtering policy is what blocks known malware and phishing sites for people wherever they work.

checks.title: Private apps reached through Private Access
remediation: Install Private Network connectors in each network that hosts private apps, two or more per site.
Enable the Private Access traffic profile and publish the apps (Quick Access or per-app segments).
Require MFA and a compliant device for each app with Conditional Access, then retire the VPN for those apps.

userImpact.text: People reach internal apps without starting a VPN, after signing in like any other Microsoft 365 app.

checks.narrative: A VPN puts a device on the network and trusts it there. Private Access publishes each app on its own, behind Conditional Access, so a stolen password or an infected laptop reaches one app at most, not the whole network.

checks.title: Conditional Access sees the original source address
remediation: In Entra, Global Secure Access, Settings, Session management, Adaptive access, turn on Enable Global Secure Access signaling in Conditional Access.

userImpact.text: Nothing visible; sign-in logs and named locations see people's real addresses.

checks.narrative: Without signaling, traffic through Global Secure Access reaches Entra from Microsoft's addresses, so named locations, sign-in risk and the sign-in log see the service instead of the person. Source IP restoration gives Conditional Access the real address back.
